xsitk_laplacian_sharpen — 2D extra op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "xsitk_laplacian_sharpen", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Laplacian sharpening (SimpleITK `LaplacianSharpening`). A type of unsharp masking that enhances edges by subtracting the Laplacian (second derivative) from the image. Returns the result after min-max normalization.
